The '''Nardithi Cluster''' was a collection of hexagonal spikes located on the [[planet]] [[Dathomir]]. The Cluster allowed powerful [[Force-sensitive]]s to amplify their powers, though it also pulled [[the Force]] from nearby life, which sometimes had deadly consequences. After its discovery, the cluster was occupied by a group of [[Nardithi Nightsisters|Nightsisters]]. The clan removed the cluster from its original site and caused it to become steeped in the [[dark side of the Force]].

Before leaving to be trained by [[Jerserra's master|her master]], [[Jerserra]], a member of the Nardithi Nightsisters, took a shard of the Cluster. The shard was thoroughly studied by them over the course of several years.<ref name="GoD">''[[Ghosts of Dathomir]]''</ref>

[[File:AloenDresk-FDGD.png|thumb|right|150px|Aloen Dresk examining a shard of the Cluster]]
When a salvage expert found a piece of the collection, the salvage operative [[Aloen Dresk]] felt a connection with it through the Force and stole it. The piece was eventually passed down his family until it became in possession of [[Yeel Dresk]]. Yeel hired [[Corellian]] [[artist]] [[Quek Rai]] to add it to the ''[[Tragic Hope]]''. The ''Tragic Hope'' would stand in the shop of the [[merchant]] [[Walisi]].<ref name="GoD" />
